description: This file is a shell script designed for testing or automating git blame operations to analyze the history and blame information related to a specific file ('file.t') within a git repository. It sets up a sample commit history, performs blame commands with specific options, and verifies the output.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes to files.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge of commits or branches.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success with a description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables.
